name: 60175 · Saint Charles, IL
findings: ZIP 60175 (Saint Charles) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60175 (Saint Charles) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
